# whisper_cpp v0.4.0 - Table of Contents

> Native Elixir bindings for whisper.cpp. Accepts 16 kHz mono f32 PCM and runs on CPU, CUDA, ROCm (hipBLAS), Metal, Vulkan, or CoreML.

## Pages

- [whisper_cpp](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)
- [Changelog](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)
- [whisper_cpp usage rules](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/usage-rules.md)

## Modules

- [WhisperCpp](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.md): Native Elixir bindings for [whisper.cpp](https://github.com/ggerganov/whisper.cpp).

- Result structs
  - [WhisperCpp.Segment](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Segment.md): One segment of a whisper.cpp transcription.
  - [WhisperCpp.Transcription](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Transcription.md): Result of a `WhisperCpp.transcribe/3` call.
  - [WhisperCpp.Word](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Word.md): One word produced by `:word_timestamps`.

- Handles
  - [WhisperCpp.AbortHandle](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.AbortHandle.md): Cooperative cancellation handle for `WhisperCpp.transcribe/3`.
  - [WhisperCpp.Model](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Model.md): Loaded whisper.cpp model handle.

- Errors
  - [WhisperCpp.Error](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Error.md): Structured error returned from `WhisperCpp` calls.

- Internal
  - [WhisperCpp.Native](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Native.md): Low-level Rustler bindings to whisper.cpp via the `whisper-rs` crate.
  - [WhisperCpp.Pcm](https://whisper-cpp.hexdocs.pm/WhisperCpp.Pcm.md): Helpers for slicing little-endian f32 PCM buffers without re-decoding
the source audio.
